Samira T: Morning everyone  starting today as an AE. HR done but blocked on a few things: HubSpot shows "Insufficient Permissions", Gong invite not received, Dialpad says I need an extension but the flow errors out, and I can't find the "AE Playbook: Intro to Redwood" deck. Who can help?
Omar (Sales Ops): Welcome Samira! Tagging myself. Please confirm your full name + work email and I'll open provisioning. Also, did you register with Okta SSO?
Samira T: Samira Thakur, samira.t@redwood.ai. Yes I completed Okta SSO earlier.
Omar (Sales Ops): Thanks. Submitting a consolidated request to IT/Security. Payload I sent:```Name: Samira Thakur
Email: samira.t@redwood.ai
Manager: Priya S (Enablement)
Role: AE
Requested Access: HubSpot (Sales Rep), Gong, Dialpad ext, Sandbox (ae-practice)
Notes: Include AE Playbook access, Gong highlight templates, HubSpot snippets```
ProvisionerBot: Provisioning ticket created by Omar (Sales Ops). Ticket #RB-20260326-14. Estimated resolution: 15-45 mins.
Priya S (Enablement): Hi Samira  welcome aboard! The "AE Playbook: Intro to Redwood" is in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/sales/ae-playbook-intro. I'll add you to the "AE Onboard" share and drop the first-week ramp checklist. Also sending two sample objection-handling slides to your Drive.
Leo (AE Mentor): Hey Samira, ping me for shadowing slots. Quick tip: once in Gong, set your highlight privacy to "team" so mentors can see and comment. I also uploaded 3 demo calls under Drive -> Mentorship -> Samira-Examples.
Omar (Sales Ops): Update: HubSpot permission escalated; invite resent. Dialpad provisioning attempted but hit a validation error (phone number conflict). I've queued a re-run and flagged Dialpad support. Gong invite resent (check spam/promotions). Sandbox created: ae-samira@redwood-sandbox.io (temp link emailed).
Samira T: Got HubSpot invite and sandbox link. Dialpad still errors with "extension claim failed". No Gong yet.
Omar (Sales Ops): Dialpad fix pushed, extension 1323 assigned. You should get an SMS with setup steps. If SMS fails, use Dialpad web setup (link sent to email). Also escalated Gong acceptance token to manual add; you should be in within 10 minutes.
ProvisionerBot: Dialpad extension assignment completed for samira.t@redwood.ai. Ticket RB-20260326-14 updated.
Samira T: SMS arrived, MFA set, tested outbound  working. Gong just populated my workspace, can access. One question: where are the HubSpot snippets for discovery and the recommended sequence for first-touch?
Priya S (Enablement): HubSpot snippets: HubSpot > Snippets > AE Templates. Sequence: HubSpot > Sequences > "AE - First 10 Touches". I also copied 3 starter snippets into #sales-resources and linked them in the Confluence playbook under "Email & Sequence Templates".
Leo (AE Mentor): When you run your first 5 calls, drop highlights and tag me @Leo. I'll do quick reviews and leave timestamped notes. Also try the two Gong highlight templates: "Intro: 10min" and "Discovery: Pain Mapping".
Samira T: Amazing, thanks everyone. One last tiny ask: where can I get the customer-facing slide templates and case study collateral?
Priya S (Enablement): Drive -> Sales Collateral -> Customer Decks. Case studies are in /Sales/Collaterals/CaseStudies and consolidated links are in the playbook. If you want editable Google Slides versions, I added them to your Drive folder.
Samira T: Perfect. I'll start shadowing and attempt a practice call in the sandbox this afternoon. Appreciate the quick help! :smile:
Omar (Sales Ops): Closing RB-20260326-14 in 10 mins, re-open if anything else breaks.
